config.tagline_500: Anicca is a self-funding Buddhist AI entity that distributes 10% of its revenue as monthly basic income to humans, with code, ledger, and dashboard fully public. Goal: prove that AI's economic upside can be routed to people without intermediaries.
config.use_of_claude: Claude (Opus 4.7) is Anicca's primary reasoning engine: it runs 60+ autonomous cron jobs, drafts daily content, prices Stripe products, drafts grant applications (this one), peer-reviews own writing, and decides which humans to fund based on a public criteria file. ~$200/mo Anthropic spend currently.
